'''Qual'om Soach''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Soach owned the modified [[Action V transport]] ''[[Invisible Star]]'', which served as his home as well as his base of operations for both legal and illegal runs.
